paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, both related to Fermi receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas, as reported by Bloomberg.com and Bloomberg. The subpoena is for certain documents related to the project.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with an annualized base salary of $750,000. Additionally, there was 1 Form 4 filing and 10 new social posts in the last 24 hours.
